architecture: Compose the shared matrix sources, time dimensions and aggregates. No handler for this wording/year/month.
intent: Compare daily ordered units and financial realizations between years to assess whether an observed November decline repeats the prior-year pattern.
canonical_utterance: Сравни заказы и реализации за октябрь и ноябрь прошлого и текущего года по дням и проверь, повторяется ли ноябрьский спад.

sources.role: preferred source and independent control when accessible; HTTP400 is not zero demand
historical order-line source; cursor pagination; product quantity and Money unit price
historical order-line source; cursor pagination; no result wrapper
separate realized/reversed quantity and customer amounts by accrual date
independent historical financial controls; not a substitute for an order-date cohort

normalization.orders: deduplicate posting_number; sum product.quantity; preserve all statuses for original ordered demand; show cancellations separately; convert timestamps to Moscow before day grouping
normalization.boundaries: convert local period boundaries to UTC for source acquisition; include required boundary pages, never infer missing days as zero
normalization.money: product.price Money {amount,currency} is unit price; legacy strings only with explicit matching currency; financial commission.sale_price is line amount
normalization.returns: negative signed product accruals are separate reversals/corrections; physical return date not inferred

aggregates: last seven completed days of previous month

comparison_rules.primary: ordered units for demand, realized units shown separately
comparison_rules.month_to_date: compare equal completed dates, not a partial month with a full month
comparison_rules.seasonality: prior-year November/October daily-rate ratio is descriptive, not proof of market seasonality
comparison_rules.causal_claim: unknown unless price,availability,advertising and market controls are obtained; do not infer causal elasticity or local defect from two periods

coverage_guards: all requested calendar days and terminal cursors accounted for
unknown/missing dates explicit, future values blank
all monetary identities and currencies validated
do not silently replace ordered units with realized units
llm_role: Translate question to approved matrix plan and explain computed results; no arithmetic or invented source fields.
